footnote_text: The sale of shares of common stock of Intapp, Inc. was executed pursuant to a 10b5-1 plan put in place by the Reporting Person on May 13, 2026. || The price reported in Column 4 is a weighted average price. These shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $44.13 to $45.01, inclusive. The reporting person undertakes to provide to Intapp, Inc., any security holder of Intapp, Inc. or the staff of the Securities and Exchange Commission, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price within the range set forth in this footnote (3).

The reported transaction involved the reporting person's receipt of a grant of restricted share units under the Intapp, Inc. 2021 Omnibus Incentive Plan.  Each restricted share unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of Intapp, Inc. common stock.
